Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide hl7.at.fhir.prenudge.appdata.r4

PreNUDGEAppdataR4

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir.hl7.at/prenudge/appdata/r4/ImplementationGuide/hl7.at.fhir.prenudge.appdata.r4

The FHIR® implementation guide for the delivery of data from apps and other providers to the PreNUDGE platform. Authored by the PreNUDGE platform provider.

name: PreNUDGEAppdataR4
title: PreNUDGE FHIR® IG for Data Provider / Data from Apps (R4)
description: The FHIR® implementation guide for the delivery of data from apps and other providers to the PreNUDGE platform. Authored by the PreNUDGE platform provider.

Automatically added as a dependency - all IGs depend on the HL7 Extension Pack

resource.name: Alcohol Use O - Moderate (3-4 times weekly)
resource.description: Example of an alcohol use observation for a moderate drinker consuming alcohol 3-4 times per week (0.5 drinks per day).

resource.name: Alcohol Use O mapped from Q - Daily
resource.description: Example of an alcohol use observation for a daily drinker (1 drink per day).

resource.name: Alcohol Use O mapped from Q - Non-Drinker
resource.description: Example of an alcohol use observation for a lifetime non-drinker (0 drinks per day).

resource.name: Alcohol Use Q - Daily
resource.description: Example  of an alcohol use observation for a daily drinker.

resource.name: Alcohol Use Q - Non-Drinker
resource.description: Example  of an alcohol use observation for a lifetime non-drinker.

resource.name: Alkoholkonsum im letzten Jahr
resource.description: Categorical variable for the frequency of alcohol consumption in the last year (IPS compatible).

resource.name: Arbeitsbezogenes Kohärenzgefühl (Work-SoC)
resource.description: Work-related Sense of Coherence (Work-SoC) questionnaire. The raw item responses are collected in the QuestionnaireResponse. Category scores are defined as SDC calculated expressions and may be mapped to a Work-SoC score Observation.

resource.name: Arbeitsfähigkeit (WAI Kurzmodul)
resource.description: Short Work Ability Index (WAI) questionnaire module based on Tuomi et al. 1998. The raw answers are collected as QuestionnaireResponse.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Alcohol Use Frequency
resource.description: Frequencies used in the PreNUDGE alcoholuse questionnaire.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE ATHIS Answer Options
resource.description: Complete set of answer options from the ATHIS questionnaire (Austrian Health Interview Survey (Österreichische Gesundheitsbefragung, STATISTIK AUSTRIA, version 2025-03-31). Codes are in English; display values remain in German (original questionnaire wording). Grouped by scale type. Note: existing PreNUDGE CodeSystems remain valid – whoqol-bref-scale (LQ16 satisfaction scale), prenudge-alcoholuse-frequency (AL1, SNOMED-based).

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Blood Glucose Meal Context
resource.description: Meal context used in the PreNUDGE Blood Glucose questionnaire and observation.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Code-to-Unit Mapping
resource.description: Maps observation codes to their expected UCUM units for the 'Other Quantities' observation profile.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE ISCED-based Education Category Codes
resource.description: Local representation of the eight ISCED-based answer categories for the highest completed education level used in PreNUDGE.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE ISCED-based Education Category ValueSet
resource.description: Permitted ISCED-based answer categories for the highest completed education level.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Nutrition Consumption Frequency
resource.description: All frequency options for fruit and vegetable consumption questions DH1 and DH3 from ATHIS 2025, including the two universal ATHIS metadata answers.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Nutrition Sugar Salty Consumption Frequency
resource.description: Analytical frequency values for sugary, fatty, and salty food consumption (ATHIS 2025 question DH6). The questionnaire's universal metadata answers are represented in Observation.dataAbsentReason and are therefore excluded from this ValueSet.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the overall Observation for PreNUDGE. It is abstract, so no instances of this profile directly are allowed. Be aware that if the user enters values from a device into a questionnaire, it is still considered a manual input. Please keep in mind that all observations must comply with the qualification matrix on https://prenudge.at/qualificationmatrix/.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Alcohol Use
resource.description: This FHIR profile is derived from the APS Observation Alcohol Use profile. Additional fields from the PreNUDGE Observation profile are added.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Blood Glucose (only in mg/dL)
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the Blood Glucose Observation, similar to the Observation Social History - Alcohol Use from the IPS. The blood glucose option only allows values inbetween 0 and 999 mg/dL.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Body Height
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines a body height Observation based on the FHIR R4 Vital Signs body height concept. Body height is represented using LOINC 8302-2 and UCUM cm.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Body Mass Index
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines a Body Mass Index (BMI) Observation based on the FHIR R4 Vital Signs BMI concept. BMI is represented using LOINC 39156-5 and UCUM kg/m2.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Body Weight
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines a body weight Observation based on the FHIR R4 Vital Signs body weight concept. Body weight is represented using LOINC 29463-7 and UCUM kg.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Highest Completed Education
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines the person's highest completed education level using the eight ISCED-based PreNUDGE answer categories. It is intended for sociodemographic data collected by a simple questionnaire.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Methods
resource.description: ValueSet containing SNOMED CT codes for differentiating methods used in the PreNUDGE observation.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Muscle Strengthening Sessions
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines the Muscle Strengthening Sessions Observation recording the number of muscle-strengthening exercise sessions (e.g. weight training, resistance exercises with weights, resistance bands, or bodyweight) per week. Applicable for both automated wearable measurements (method = Automated) and self-reported values derived from questionnaires (method = Manual). A numeric value must be 0 or greater; ATHIS metadata answers are represented using dataAbsentReason.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Nutrition Fruit Portions
resource.description: Records self-reported daily portions of fruit based on ATHIS 2025 question DH2. Applicable only for respondents who eat fruit daily (DH1 = 'Täglich oder mehrmals täglich'). Observation code: LOINC 80457-5 'Fruit servings 24 hour Estimated'.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Nutrition Sugar Salty Frequency
resource.description: Records self-reported consumption frequency of sugary, fatty, and salty foods and energy-dense drinks, based on ATHIS 2025 question DH6. Coded using SNOMED CT 364395008 'Dietary intake (observable entity)' as the observation concept; update if a more specific LOINC code is identified for this measurement.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Nutrition Vegetable Portions
resource.description: Records self-reported daily portions of vegetables or salad based on ATHIS 2025 question DH4. Applicable only for respondents who eat vegetables daily (DH3 = 'Täglich oder mehrmals täglich'). Observation code: LOINC 80459-1 'Vegetable servings 24 hour Estimated'.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Other not Quantities
resource.description: This FHIR profile can be used for all the other Observations for PreNUDGE, not being an quantity and not fitting the existing narrow standardized observations.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Other Quantities
resource.description: This FHIR profile can be used for all the other Observations for PreNUDGE, beeing quantities and not fitting the existing narrow standardized observations. If some code for specifying a new Observation is missing, please contact prenudge@joanneum.at.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Physical Activity Minutes
resource.description:
Observation profile for recording physical activity duration as a panel
(moderate, vigorous, aggregate components) derived from either a wearable device or
the EHIS-PAQ/ATHIS questionnaire (Q7/PE7). Supports four valid component combinations:
  (a) aggregate only           — questionnaire source (Q7/PE7 → aggregateActivity)
  (b) moderate only            — manual source; vigorous implicitly 0,
                                 aggregate = moderateActivity (pa-agg-01 warning
                                 if aggregateActivity absent)
  (c) moderate + aggregate     — partial wearable or manual source
  (d) vigorous + aggregate     — partial wearable source
  (e) all three                — full wearable source.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation PSS-10 Score
resource.description: Observation profile for recording the calculated PSS-10 total score (LOINC 106860-0). Observation.value holds the integer total score (0–40). Components hold the raw categorical answers per item (bound to the PSS frequency ValueSet). Derived from a completed PSS-10 QuestionnaireResponse.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation PSS-4 Score
resource.description: Observation profile for recording the calculated PSS-4 total score. Observation.value holds the integer total score (0–16). Components hold the raw categorical answers per item (bound to the PSS frequency ValueSet). Derived from a completed PSS-4 QuestionnaireResponse.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Sitting Hours
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines the Sitting Hours Observation recording the average number of sitting or resting hours per day (excluding sleep). Applicable for both automated wearable measurements (method = Automated) and self-reported values derived from EhisPaqSittingHoursQuestionnaire via SittingHoursQuestionnaireResponseToObservation (method = Manual). Device-derived sitting hours are computed as: Sitting Hours = 24 h − Active Hours − Sleep Hours, where Active Hours (Stehstunden) are hours in which a person has moved at least once (≥ 50 steps per hour). Sleep hours must be subtracted by the originating app before recording the value.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Sleep Duration
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines the Sleep Duration Observation recording average nightly sleep in hours. Applicable for both automated wearable measurements (method = automated) and self-reported values derived from a questionnaire (method = manual).

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Sleep Quality
resource.description: Records the self-assessed sleep quality from PROMIS (My sleep quality was...in past 7 days). Also used to map WHOQOL-BREF Q16 from standalone SleepQualityQuestionnaire or the full WhoQolBrefQuestionnaire.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Smoking Status
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the current smoking status observation for PreNUDGE. It is derived from the APS Observation Tobacco Use profile, which imposes the IPS Observation Social History - Tobacco Use profile. The value is derived from the ATHIS-based SmokingStatusQuestionnaire, primarily from SK1 and, if SK1 is negative, from the past tobacco smoking question. Additional fields from the PreNUDGE Observation profile are added.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Step Count
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the Step Count Observation. The step count only allows values inbetween 0 and 150,000 steps per 24 hours.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Whooley Depression Screening
resource.description: Records the binary result of the PHQ-2/Whooley depression screening (Ja/Nein-Version) as referenced in the Nationale VersorgungsLeitlinie Depression (AWMF nvl-005, https://register.awmf.org/de/leitlinien/detail/nvl-005). The reference period is the last month (letzter Monat), not the standard PHQ-2 period of two weeks. Interpretation of valueCodeableConcept: SNOMED CT 10828004 (Positive) = both Whooley questions answered 'Ja' (positive depression screen); SNOMED CT 260385009 (Negative) = at least one answer was 'Nein' (negative screen). Werden beide Fragen mit 'Ja' beantwortet, identifiziert der Test das Vorliegen depressiver Störungen mit einer Sensitivität von 96 % und einer Spezifität von 57 % (NVL Depression, AWMF nvl-005).

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation WHOQOL-BREF Score
resource.description: Observation profile for recording WHOQOL-BREF domain scores. The overall score is represented in Observation.value, individual domain scores are recorded as components.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Observation Work-SoC Category Score
resource.description: This FHIR profile defines the calculated work-related sense of coherence (Work-SoC) category score observation. It contains the category scores for comprehensibility, manageability and meaningfulness as Observation components. The raw Work-SoC item answers are represented in the source QuestionnaireResponse.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Other Observations Codes
resource.description: Allowed observation codes for the 'Other' observation profile.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Other Observations Units
resource.description: Allowed UCUM units for the 'Other' observation profile.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Physical Activity Classification Method CodeSystem
resource.description: Codes for the algorithm or technique used to classify the intensity of a physical activity measurement into moderate / vigorous categories.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Physical Activity Classification Method ValueSet
resource.description: ValueSet containing all codes from the AT PreNUDGE Physical Activity Classification Method CodeSystem. Used as the required binding for component[classificationMethod].value[x] in the AT PreNUDGE Observation Physical Activity Minutes profile.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE PSS Frequency Answer Scale
resource.description: 5-point frequency answer scale (0–4) used by the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-4 and PSS-10) instruments. Based on Cohen, S., Kamarck, T., & Mermelstein, R. (1983). A global measure of perceived stress. Journal of Health and Social Behavior, 24(4), 385–396.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE PSS Instrument Codes
resource.description: IG-internal codes for PSS-4 instrument identification and per-item Observation component codes for PSS-4 and PSS-10.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Questionnaire
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the overall Questionnaire for PreNUDGE. Every top level item requires one comment subitem, with the linkId ending or equal 'comment'. Be aware that if the user enters values from a device into a questionnaire, it is still considered a manual input. Please keep in mind that all questionnaires must comply with the qualification matrix on https://prenudge.at/qualificationmatrix/.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Questionnaire Response
resource.description: This FHIR profile is defining the overall Questionnaire Response for PreNUDGE. Be aware that if the user enters values from a device into a questionnaire, it is still considered a manual input. Please keep in mind that all questionnaire responses must comply with the qualification matrix on https://prenudge.at/qualificationmatrix/.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE ValueSet PSS Frequency Answer Scale
resource.description: All five PSS frequency answer options (Nie–Sehr oft) used in PSS-4 and PSS-10 questionnaire items.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE ValueSet Whooley Screen Result
resource.description: Binary result of the PHQ-2; "Whooley" Questions (Ja/Nein-Version). Positive = both questions answered 'Ja'; Negative = at least one question answered 'Nein'.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE WAI Answer Codes
resource.description: Local answer codes for categorical Work Ability Index answer options.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE WAI Physical Demands Answer ValueSet
resource.description: Permitted categorical answers for current work ability in relation to physical work demands.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE WHOQOL-BREF Answer Scales
resource.description: Consolidated CodeSystem for all answer scales of the WHOQOL-BREF questionnaire.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE WHOQOL-BREF Score Type ValueSet
resource.description: ValueSet containing SNOMED CT codes for differentiating WHOQOL-BREF overall and domain scores.

resource.name: AT PreNUDGE Workability Codes
resource.description: Local PreNUDGE codes for workability questionnaires and derived Work-SoC score observations. Work-SoC source DOI: https://doi.org/10.4102/sajip.v39i1.1111

resource.name: AtApsPatient-example
resource.description: An example of a patient with a license to krill.

resource.name: Blood Glucose O - Low Example
resource.description: Example of a low fasting blood glucose measurement (62 mg/dL), indicating hypoglycemia.

resource.name: Blood Glucose O mapped from Q - Elevated Example
resource.description: Example of an elevated fasting blood glucose measurement (142 mg/dL), indicating diabetes mellitus.

resource.name: Blood Glucose O mapped from Q - Normal Example
resource.description: Example of a normal fasting blood glucose measurement (95 mg/dL).

resource.name: Blood Glucose Q - Elevated Example
resource.description: Example of an elevated fasting blood glucose measurement (142 mg/dL), indicating diabetes mellitus.

resource.name: Blood Glucose Q - Normal Example
resource.description: Example of a normal fasting blood glucose measurement (95 mg/dL).

resource.name: Blutzucker bei der letzten Messung
resource.description: A simple questionnaire for asking how high the blood glucose level is right now. The blood glucose option only allows values inbetween 0 and 999 mg/dL.

resource.name: BMI Questionnaire Response Example
resource.description: Example of a BMI questionnaire response with body height, body weight and a calculated BMI value.

resource.name: Body Height O - Example
resource.description: Example body height Observation derived from a BMI questionnaire response.

resource.name: Body Mass Index O - Example
resource.description: Example BMI Observation derived from a BMI questionnaire response.

resource.name: Body Weight O - Example
resource.description: Example body weight Observation derived from a BMI questionnaire response.

resource.name: Durchschnittliche Schlafdauer pro Nacht
resource.description: A simple questionnaire for self-reporting average sleep duration per night in hours. Only allows values between 0 and 24 hours.

resource.name: Education O mapped from Q - ISCED 3c Example
resource.description: Example of a highest completed education observation mapped from the EducationQuestionnaire.

resource.name: Education O mapped from Q - ISCED 6–8 Higher Education Example
resource.description: Example of a highest completed education observation mapped from the EducationQuestionnaire.

resource.name: Education Q - ISCED 3c Example
resource.description: Example of a highest completed education questionnaire response using the ISCED 3c category.

resource.name: Education Q - ISCED 6–8 Higher Education Example
resource.description: Example of a highest completed education questionnaire response using the grouped ISCED 6–8 category.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q7 / ATHIS PE7 Physical Activity - Example Response
resource.description:
Example EHIS-PAQ Q7 / ATHIS PE7 physical activity questionnaire response:
Q4 = 3 Tage pro Woche (Fahrrad, Transport),
Q5 = 30 bis 59 Minuten pro Tag (Fahrrad),
Q6 = 5 Tage pro Woche (Freizeit-Sport),
Q7 = 2 Stunden 30 Minuten (= 150 min/Woche).
Q7 maps to physical-activity-questionnaire-example via the StructureMap.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8 Muscle Strengthening Q - Example Response
resource.description: Example QuestionnaireResponse for EhisPaqMuscleStrengtheningQuestionnaire: respondent selects 3 days per week of muscle-strengthening exercise.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8 Muscle Strengthening Q - Unknown Example
resource.description: Example QuestionnaireResponse using the universal ATHIS answer 'Weiß nicht'.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8: Muskelkräftigungsübungen
resource.description:
EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8: number of
days per week on which the respondent performs physical activities specifically aimed at
building or strengthening muscles (e.g. weight training, resistance-band exercises,
bodyweight exercises, squats, push-ups, sit-ups). Answer options use existing ATHIS
CodeSystem codes activity-1-day through activity-7-days. Two mapping paths to
AtPrenudgeObservationMuscleStrengthening are available: (1) directly from this
questionnaire via MuscleStrengtheningEhisPaqQuestionnaireResponseToObservation
(translates coded day-count to numeric sessions/wk: 1 day = 1 session/wk, …, 7 days
= 7 sessions/wk); (2) via MuscleStrengtheningQuantityQuestionnaire and
MuscleStrengtheningQuestionnaireResponseToObservation when a numeric quantity answer
is preferred.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q9 / ATHIS PE9 Sitting Hours Q – Example Response
resource.description: Example QuestionnaireResponse for EhisPaqSittingHoursQuestionnaire: respondent reports 6 hours and 30 minutes of sitting or resting per day (sleep excluded). Corresponds to sitting-hours-questionnaire-derived-example (6.5 h) via SittingHoursQuestionnaireResponseToObservation.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ Q9 / ATHIS PE9: Sitzen und Ruhen
resource.description:
EHIS-PAQ Q9 / ATHIS PE9: total time spent sitting or resting on a
typical day (excluding sleep), captured as two integer sub-items (hours 0–23,
minutes 0–60). Mapped to AtPrenudgeObservationSittingHours via
SittingHoursQuestionnaireResponseToObservation (hours + minutes/60 → valueQuantity
in h).

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ/ATHIS: Körperliche Aktivität
resource.description:
Questions Q4–Q7 from the European Health Interview Survey Physical Activity
Questionnaire (EHIS-PAQ), equivalent to ATHIS PE4–PE7: cycling for transport
(Q4/PE4: days per week, Q5/PE5: duration per day), leisure sport and physical
activity in leisure time (Q6/PE6: days per week, Q7/PE7: total duration per week).
Q7 is mapped to Observation via PhysicalActivityMinutesQtoO;
Q4–Q6 are captured only.

resource.name: EHIS-PAQ/ATHIS: Zu-Fuß-Gehen
resource.description:
Questions Q2–Q3 from the European Health Interview Survey Physical Activity
Questionnaire (EHIS-PAQ), equivalent to ATHIS PE2–PE3: number of days per week on
which the respondent walks for transport (Q2/PE2, integer 0–7) and the typical
duration of that walking per day (Q3/PE3, coded using ATHIS group 9 answer set).

resource.name: Höchster abgeschlossener Bildungsabschluss
resource.description: A simple questionnaire asking for the person's highest completed education level using eight ISCED-based answer categories.

resource.name: Konsumhäufigkeit fett-, zucker- und salzreicher Lebensmittel
resource.description: Questionnaire based on ATHIS 2025 question DH6 (STATISTIK AUSTRIA) to self-report the weekly consumption frequency of sugary, fatty, and salty foods and energy-dense drinks.

resource.name: Körpergröße, Körpergewicht und Body Mass Index (BMI)
resource.description: Questionnaire for self-reporting body height and body weight. The Body Mass Index (BMI) is defined as an SDC calculated expression based on height in cm and weight in kg. The QuestionnaireResponse may be mapped to separate body height, body weight and BMI Observations.

resource.name: Muscle Strengthening Sessions O - Wearable Automated Example
resource.description: Example of an automatically detected muscle strengthening sessions count (5 sessions per week) measured by a wearable fitness tracker.

resource.name: Muscle Strengthening Sessions O mapped from ATHIS - Unknown Example
resource.description: Example derived from an ATHIS 'Weiß nicht' response; no numeric frequency is asserted.

resource.name: Muscle Strengthening Sessions O mapped from EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8 - Example
resource.description: Example of a self-reported muscle strengthening sessions count (3 sessions per week) derived from EhisPaqMuscleStrengtheningQuestionnaire via MuscleStrengtheningEhisPaqQuestionnaireResponseToObservation. ATHIS code activity-3-days is translated to the numeric value 3.

resource.name: Muscle Strengthening Sessions O mapped from Q - Example
resource.description: Example of a self-reported muscle strengthening sessions count (3 sessions per week) derived from MuscleStrengtheningQuantityQuestionnaire.

resource.name: Muscle Strengthening Sessions Q - Example Response
resource.description: Example QuestionnaireResponse for MuscleStrengtheningQuantityQuestionnaire: respondent reports 3 muscle-strengthening exercise sessions per week.

resource.name: Muskelkräftigungs-Trainingseinheiten pro Woche (numerisch)
resource.description: A numeric questionnaire for directly entering the number of muscle-strengthening exercise sessions per week. Designed for direct FML mapping to the AT PreNUDGE Observation Muscle Strengthening Sessions profile via MuscleStrengtheningQuestionnaireResponseToObservation. Use EhisPaqMuscleStrengtheningQuestionnaire for the categorical EHIS-PAQ Q8 / ATHIS PE8 representation.

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit & Veg Q - ATHIS Metadata Answers Example
resource.description: Example response using 'Weiß nicht' for fruit frequency and 'Keine Angabe' for vegetable frequency.

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit & Veg Q - Daily Eater Example
resource.description: Example response for a daily fruit and vegetable eater: fruit daily (DH1), 3 portions of fruit (DH2), vegetables daily (DH3), 2 portions of vegetables (DH4).

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit & Veg Q - Non-Daily Eater Example
resource.description: Example response for a non-daily fruit and vegetable eater: fruit 4–6 times per week (DH1, DH2 not enabled), vegetables 1–3 times per week (DH3, DH4 not enabled).

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit Portions O mapped from Q - High Intake Example
resource.description: Example of 5 daily fruit portions, indicating high fruit intake.

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit Portions O mapped from Q - Normal Example
resource.description: Example of 3 daily fruit portions, derived from a questionnaire response (daily eater, DH2 = 3).

resource.name: Nutrition Fruit Portions O mapped from Q - Unknown Example
resource.description: Example derived from the universal ATHIS answer 'Weiß nicht' to DH1.

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Frequency O mapped from Q - Daily Example
resource.description: Example of daily consumption of sugary, fatty, and salty foods, derived from a questionnaire response (DH6 = code#1).

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Frequency O mapped from Q - Not Stated Example
resource.description: Example derived from the universal ATHIS answer 'Keine Angabe'.

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Frequency O mapped from Q - Rare Example
resource.description: Example of less-than-once-weekly consumption of sugary, fatty, and salty foods (DH6 = code#4).

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Q - Daily Consumption Example
resource.description: Example response for daily or multiple-times-daily consumption of sugary, fatty, and salty foods (DH6 = code#1).

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Q - Not Stated Example
resource.description: Example response using the universal ATHIS answer 'Keine Angabe'.

resource.name: Nutrition Sugar Salty Q - Rare Consumption Example
resource.description: Example response for less-than-once-weekly consumption of sugary, fatty, and salty foods (DH6 = code#4).

resource.name: Nutrition Vegetable Portions O mapped from Q - High Intake Example
resource.description: Example of 4 daily vegetable and salad portions, indicating high vegetable intake.

resource.name: Nutrition Vegetable Portions O mapped from Q - Normal Example
resource.description: Example of 2 daily vegetable and salad portions, derived from a questionnaire response (daily eater, DH4 = 2).

resource.name: Nutrition Vegetable Portions O mapped from Q - Not Stated Example
resource.description: Example derived from the universal ATHIS answer 'Keine Angabe' to DH3.

resource.name: Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10)
resource.description: 10-item Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10; LOINC 106875-8) measuring subjective experience of stress over the past four weeks. Scoring: items q4, q5, q7, q8 are positive items reversed (4 – ordinal); items q1, q2, q3, q6, q9, q10 are used as-is. Total score range 0–40; higher scores indicate greater perceived stress.

resource.name: Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-4)
resource.description: 4-item short version of the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-4) measuring subjective experience of stress over the past month. Scoring: items pss4-q2 and pss4-q3 are positive items reversed (4 – ordinal); items pss4-q1 and pss4-q4 are used as-is. Total score range 0–16; higher scores indicate greater perceived stress.

resource.name: PHQ-2; "Whooley Questions"
resource.description: Short screening for emotional burden and depressive disorders (Whooley Questions / PHQ-2 Yes/No version) as referenced in the Nationale VersorgungsLeitlinie (NVL) Depression (AWMF nvl-005, https://register.awmf.org/de/leitlinien/detail/nvl-005). Reference period: last month (deviating from the standard PHQ-2 period of two weeks). When both questions are answered 'Yes', the instrument identifies depressive disorders with a sensitivity of 96% and a specificity of 57%.

resource.name: Physical Activity Minutes O - (a) Aggregate Only (Manual)
resource.description:
Scenario (a): only component[aggregateActivity] is present.
Typical for a questionnaire-derived observation that asks only for total activity
time without splitting moderate and vigorous.  pa-agg-01 passes silently because
neither moderate nor vigorous is present.

resource.name: Physical Activity Minutes O - (b) Moderate Only (Manual, pa-agg-01 warning)
resource.description:
Scenario (b): only component[moderateActivity] is present; aggregate absent.
pa-agg-01 fires a WARNING because moderateActivity is present but aggregateActivity
is not.  The aggregate should equal moderateActivity + (0 × 2) = 150 min/wk;
a sender should add component[aggregateActivity] = 150 min/wk to suppress the warning.
This scenario may arise when a source captures moderate activity but omits the aggregate.

resource.name: Physical Activity Minutes O - (c) Moderate + Aggregate (Manual)
resource.description:
Scenario (c): component[moderateActivity] and component[aggregateActivity] present;
vigorousActivity absent (implicitly 0).  aggregateActivity = moderateActivity + (0 × 2) = 90 min/wk.
pa-agg-01 is satisfied.  Typical for a structured questionnaire that reports
moderate-intensity activity separately and includes the computed aggregate.

resource.name: Physical Activity Minutes O - (d) Vigorous + Aggregate (Automated, HRZ)
resource.description:
Scenario (d): component[vigorousActivity] and component[aggregateActivity] present;
moderateActivity absent (implicitly 0).  aggregateActivity = 0 + (vigorousActivity × 2) = 150 min/wk.
classificationMethod = hrz (Heart Rate Zones, moderate 50–70% HRmax; vigorous >70% HRmax).
Typical for a wearable that identifies only vigorous bouts via heart rate but does not
separately count moderate bouts.

resource.name: Physical Activity Minutes O - (e) All Three Components (Automated, MET-Cal)
resource.description:
Scenario (e): all three Quantity components present.
moderateActivity = 120 min/wk, vigorousActivity = 60 min/wk,
aggregateActivity = 120 + (60 × 2) = 240 min/wk.
classificationMethod = met-cal (MET estimated from accelerometer / VO2 proxy).
This is the richest Observation variant, produced by a full wearable pipeline
